The development program name for the tank is ''Modern Medium Weight Tank'' (''MMWT''). The tank itself is called '''Kaplan MT''' by Turkey and '''Harimau''' by Indonesia, both meaning "[[tiger]]" ==History== The governments of Indonesia and Turkey first agreed in May 2015 to jointly develop the MMWT for the Indonesian Army at a reported cost of 30 million US dollars.{{cite web|last1=Gumilang|first1=Prima|title=Industri Pertahanan Akan Teken Kerja Sama di Indo Defence|url=http://www.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20161101144434-20-169386/industri-pertahanan-akan-teken-kerja-sama-di-indo-defence/|website=CNN Indonesia|access-date=2 November 2016|language=id|date=2 November 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161104001736/http://www.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20161101144434-20-169386/industri-pertahanan-akan-teken-kerja-sama-di-indo-defence/|archive-date=4 November 2016|url-status=live}} The development phase of the program was expected to take up to 37 months, with the first prototype being built in Turkey, and the second in Indonesia.{{cite web|title=Turkey, Indonesia agree to develop medium-weight tank|url=http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/turkey-indonesia-agree-to-develop-medium-weight-tank-----.aspx?pageID=238&nid=82091|access-date=2 November 2016|location=Ankara|date=7 May 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161103234757/http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/turkey-indonesia-agree-to-develop-medium-weight-tank-----.aspx?pageID=238&nid=82091|archive-date=3 November 2016|url-status=live}} It was agreed that the two countries would jointly own the intellectual property of the design. On 1 November 2016, during the 2016 [[Indo Defence Expo & Forum|Indo Defence Expo]], the first model of the tank was unveiled, along with some technical specifications.{{cite web|title=Light weight, low profile [INDODEF16-D1]|url=http://www.janes.com/article/65134/|website=IHS Jane's 360|access-date=2 November 2016|date=1 November 2016}} Most notably, the vehicle's overall weight was reported to be around 35 tonnes, and the main armament would be provided by a Belgian-made turret developed by [[Cockerill Maintenance & Ingénierie|CMI Defence]] featuring a 105 mm rifled barrel, capable of firing a wide range of projectiles. On 9 May 2017 at the IDEF 2017 expo, the first prototype of the tank was revealed. The tank can be fitted with either a Cockerill XC-8 105mm concept turret or Cockerill 3105 modular turret. Additionally, the tank utilizes modular armor, allowing for quick replacement upon damage.{{Cite web|url=http://www.indomiliter.com/fnss-resmi-perlihatkan-kaplan-mt-prototipe-medium-tank-garapan-bersama-pt-pindad/|title=FNSS Resmi Perlihatkan Kaplan MT, Prototipe Medium Tank Garapan Bersama PT Pindad – Indomiliter.com|website=www.indomiliter.com|date=9 May 2017|language=en-US|access-date=2017-10-04|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171004085340/http://www.indomiliter.com/fnss-resmi-perlihatkan-kaplan-mt-prototipe-medium-tank-garapan-bersama-pt-pindad/|archive-date=2017-10-04|url-status=live}} On 5 September 2018, the general manager of FNSS told Turkey's [[Anadolu Agency]] that the tank had passed months of required qualification tests for the Indonesian Army, and was ready for mass production. He stated that the first batch of 20 to 25 tanks could be ordered as early as late 2018, and that the full number of tanks to be produced would likely fall between 200 and 400.{{cite web |last1=Dominguez |first1=Gabriel |title=Kaplan MT ready for mass production, says report |url=https://www.janes.com/article/82823/kaplan-mt-ready-for-mass-production-says-report |website=IHS Jane's 360 |access-date=7 September 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180906233825/https://www.janes.com/article/82823/kaplan-mt-ready-for-mass-production-says-report |archive-date=6 September 2018 |location=London |date=6 September 2018 |url-status=live}} On 7 February 2020, it was announced that mass production of the MMWT has started.{{Cite web|url=https://www.armyrecognition.com/february_2020_global_defense_security_army_news_industry/tukish-indonesian_kaplan-harimau_medium_tank_now_in_mass_production.html|title = Tukish-Indonesian Kaplan-Harimau medium tank now in mass production | February 2020 Global Defense Security army news industry | Defense Security global news industry army 2020 | Archive News year}} In IDEF 2021 (17–20 August 2021), the production model of Harimau / Kaplan MT is revealed. Many improvements were made to the tank during the transition from prototype to mass production. In this context, driver visibility and handling ergonomics have been improved. The body design was perfected in line with the feedback from the end user. Based on the experience gained from the tests, improvements were made in the tower system, power transmission group, cooling system and suspension system.{{Cite web|title=Seri üretimdeki Kaplan tankı IDEF'te boy gösterecek|url=https://www.aa.com.tr/tr/bilim-teknoloji/seri-uretimdeki-kaplan-tanki-idefte-boy-gosterecek/2335202|access-date=2021-08-18|website=www.aa.com.tr}} One of the prototype tanks underwent series of firing tests on 24–25 February 2022 at Army Infantry Education Center Cipatat, [[West Bandung Regency]] as part of the Factory Acceptance Trials (FAT). The tank fired several rounds of HEP-T (High Explosive Plastic Tracer) and TPCSDS-T (Target Practice Cone Stabilized Discarding Sabot with Tracer) at 4x4 meters target from range of 1,250 meters in various firing positions. The tank then underwent mobility tests at a section of [[Padalarang–Cileunyi Toll Road|Padalarang-Bandung toll highway]] and at PT Pindad facility.{{cite web|url=https://www.pindad.com/pindad-sukses-lakukan-uji-tembak-medium-tank-harimau-105-mm|title=Pindad Sukses Lakukan Uji Tembak Medium Tank Harimau 105 MM|website=pindad.com|date=24 February 2022|access-date=17 May 2022|language=ID}} On 15 March 2022, a ceremony was held to mark the official completion of the first batch of 10 tanks produced at FNSS facility in Turkey. The remaining 8 turretless hull were to be sent to Indonesia after the ceremony for final turret assembly and delivery to the Indonesian Army.{{cite web|url=https://www.fnss.com.tr/en/media/news/fnss-completed-serial-production-kaplan-mt-medium-tank-platforms-are-their-way-indonesia-1430|title=FNSS Completed the Serial Production; KAPLAN MT Medium Tank Platforms are on Their Way to Indonesia|website=fnss.com.tr|date=15 March 2022|access-date=17 May 2022}} The second batch production of 8 tanks will be built by PT Pindad in Indonesia with FNSS assistance.{{cite web|url=https://www.savunmasanayist.com/endonezyanin-kaplan-mt-tanklarinin-uretimi-tamamlandi/|title=Endonezya'nın KAPLAN MT Tankları'nın Üretimi Tamamlandı|website=savunmasanayist.com|date=15 March 2022|access-date=17 May 2022|language=TR}} == Design == [[File:Purwarupa Harimau MT saat FAT (Factory Acceptance Test) 24 - 25 Februari 2022.jpg|thumb|Second prototype of the Harimau Medium Tank in February 2022 undergoing [[Factory acceptance test|Factory Acceptance Test]] (FAT)]] === Armament === The MMWT is equipped with a Cockerill CT-CV 105HP (High Pressure) 105 mm rifled gun manufactured by [[Cockerill Maintenance & Ingénierie|CMI]] (Cockerill Maintenance & Ingenierie SA Defense), with the barrel mounting a [[bore evacuator]] and [[Thermal sleeve|thermal jacket]]. The [[gun turret|turret]] is equipped with an autoloader and can be rotated 360 degrees both electronically and mechanically, with a maximum elevation/depression of 42 up to -10 degrees, and is equipped with a [[Gun stabilizer]] and Fire Control System. It is also equipped with an [[Identification friend or foe|IFF]] system, Hunter Killer System for target selection, and Auto Target Locking System to assist the gunner. === Armor === The hull armor of MMWT is using modular armor. It is categorized as STANAG 4569 level 4 protection, which means the tank can withstand [[14.5×114mm]] [[Armor-piercing ammunition|AP]] rounds at 200 meters with 911 m/s velocity. The underbelly of the tank uses V-hull, able to withstand 10 kg [[Anti-tank mine|AT mine]] under the tracks and under the center. Due to modularity, the armor can be augmented to level 5 protection (withstand 25 mm [[Armour-piercing discarding sabot|APDS-T]] at 500 m with 1258 m/s velocity) without increasing the volume of the tank, with the frontal arc able to withstand 30 mm rounds. === Mobility === Dynamic and mobility test taken in 7–16 August 2018 to prove the specification design. The tank uses a [[Caterpillar Inc.|Caterpillar]] [[Caterpillar C13|C13 diesel]] engine generating 711 hp, coupled with [[Allison Transmission|Allison]]/Caterpillar X300 transmission. During the test the tank is able to reach 78 km/h in road speed. The prototype is able to cross 2 m [[trench]] and 0.9 m vertical obstacle. === Defensive Systems === The MMWT's survivability has been further strengthened. A modular PULAT [[active protection system]] joint-developed by [[ASELSAN]] and TUBITAK SAGE can be integrated. This ensures the tank's defensive capabilities against projectiles at all-angles.{{Cite web|url=https://armyrecognition.com/idef_2019_news_online_show_daily_defense_exhibition_turkey/idef_2019_fnss_displays_for_the_first_time_kaplan_medium_tank_fitted_with_pulat_aps.html|title=FNSS Displays PULAT APS for the Kaplan Tank|date=2 May 2019|website=IDEF 2019: FNSS displays for the first time Kaplan medium tank fitted with PULAT APS|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190504032527/https://armyrecognition.com/idef_2019_news_online_show_daily_defense_exhibition_turkey/idef_2019_fnss_displays_for_the_first_time_kaplan_medium_tank_fitted_with_pulat_aps.html|archive-date=4 May 2019|url-status=live}} ==Variants== {{AI-generated section|date=July 2026}} ===Kaplan / Harimau APC=== [[File:Harimau APC in Indo Defence 2024.jpg|thumb|Harimau APC in Indo Defence 2024]] FNSS and Pindad signed an agreement in October 2024 to produce two prototypes of [[armored personnel carrier]] (APC) variant of the MMWT platform to meet the Indonesian Army contract for 30-tonnes tracked armored personnel carrier. The first prototype was built by FNSS and the second by Pindad, with both units to be delivered by 2026.{{cite web |first=Gilang |last=Perdana |url=https://www.indomiliter.com/lanjutkan-pengembangan-medium-tank-harimau-pt-pindad-dan-fnss-luncurkan-kaplan-apc-dibekali-sistem-perlindungan-modular/ |title=Lanjutkan Pengembangan Medium Tank Harimau, PT Pindad dan FNSS Luncurkan “Kaplan APC” – Dibekali Sistem Perlindungan Modular |website=indomiliter.com |date=23 October 2024 |access-date=21 July 2025 |language=ID}} The APC has a crew of three—the driver, gunner, vehicle commander—and could carry 10 troops. The Kaplan / Harimau APC was designed to be modular and could be fitted with various manned or unmanned turrets. The first Harimau APC was unveiled at the 2024 Indo Defence Expo held on 11–14 June 2025.{{cite web |url=https://www.edrmagazine.eu/fnss-pt-pindad-kaplan-harimau-apc-is-revealed-at-indo-defence-2025 |title=FNSS/PT Pindad: Kaplan/Harimau APC, is revealed at Indo Defence 2025 |website=edrmagazine.eu |date=12 June 2025 |access-date=21 July 2025}} ===Kaplan FSRV=== Kaplan Fire Support and Reconnaissance Vehicle (FSRV) is a Turkish tracked armoured fighting vehicle by FNSS, derived from the Kaplan MT. Unveiled at IDEF 2025 in Istanbul, it pairs the Kaplan chassis with the TEBER-II 30/40 two-crew turret mounting a convertible 30mm to 40mm autocannon, plus twin launchers for ATGMs or loitering munitions integrated at each sides of the turret with 4 extra stored missiles under armour compartment. Its suite includes battle-management, standard thermal sights and LSR, and automatic target tracking—with options for 360 cameras, a tube-launched or tethered drones for recon and Electronic Warfare packages. The FSRV platform is intended for ISTAR missions (intelligence, surveillance, target acquisition, and reconnaissance) and for providing direct fire support ahead of the main force, with configurations tailored for urban and drone-contested environments.{{cite web |url=https://www.fnss.com.tr/en/products/kaplan-fire-support-recce-vehicle |title=KAPLAN FSRV IDEF 2025 Unveiled |website=fnss.com |access-date=21 October 2025}}{{non primary source needed|date=July 2026}} === CFL-120 "Karpat" === The new CFL-120 Karpat medium tank was unveiled at the IDEB 2026 international defense industry exhibition in Bratislava. The vehicle is designed to provide firepower on par with main battle tanks while offering significantly lower weight and increased mobility. This collaborative project between FNSS (Turkey) and Czechoslovak Group/CSG (Czech Republic/Slovakia) effectively combines the mobility of the Kaplan MT medium tank chassis with the firepower of a large-caliber tank, Although showcased in Europe through a collaboration with a Czech/Slovak company, this integration also has historical significance considering that the basic chassis (Kaplan MT/Harimau) is a joint development program between FNSS and [[Pindad]] of [[Indonesia]], but modified with a more powerful 120mm main gun.{{cite web |url=https://militarnyi.com/en/news/czg-new-cfl-120-karpat-tank-with-120mm-gun/ |title=Czechoslovak Group Unveils New CFL-120 Karpat Medium Tank with 120mm Gun |website=militarnyi.com |access-date=2
